{'text': 'Fox News首席政治分析師Brit Hume週一指出，Donald Trump在2026年中期選舉前積極衝刺競選活動，但似乎成效不彰。', 'paragraph_context': 'Fox News chief political analyst Brit Hume argued on Monday that Donald Trump’s hitting hard of the campaign trail ahead of the2026 midterm elections appears to be having little effect.'}

{'text': '在週一播出的《Special Report With Bret Baier》節目中，Hume提到，「有時在競選過程中……你會看到一些候選人或政黨在民調中落後後開始有些起色。」', 'paragraph_context': 'On Monday’s broadcast of “Special Report With Bret Baier,” Hume noted how “sometimes in the course of a campaign … you will see a candidate or a party that’s trailing in the polls begin to catch some momentum.”'}

{'text': '他續說：「他們抓到一個議題，或者某個事件令輿論轉向有利於他們。」', 'paragraph_context': '“They hit on an issue, or an event turns public opinion in their favor,” he continued.'}

{'text': '但Hume補充道：「我到目前為止還未見到這種情況。」', 'paragraph_context': 'But Hume added: “I haven’t seen that yet.”'}

{'text': 'Hume表示，雖然Trump「一直在積極拉票」，但他「不確定這有否帶來任何分別，而即使有分別，我也不確定是有幫助的那種。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Although Trump “has been out campaigning vigorously,” Hume said he is “not sure it’s making any difference, and what difference it makes, I’m not sure is helping.”'}

{'text': '請觀看：', 'paragraph_context': 'Watch here:'}

{'text': '這位資深Fox News分析師列舉了多個近期事件，認為這些事件對Trump或共和黨候選人幫助不大，例如總統攻擊德州民主黨參議員候選人James Talarico，稱他為「Talafreako」。', 'paragraph_context': 'The veteran Fox News analyst pointed to several recent episodes he suggested have done little to help Trump or GOP candidates, such as the president’s attacks on Texas Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico as “Talafreako.”'}

{'text': 'Hume說，Talarico看起來一點也不像「怪胎」，反而「顯得溫文有禮、討人喜歡，無論你是否同意他的主張，他都是個不難看的候選人」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Talarico does not appear to be a “freak” and instead “seems mild-mannered, he seems pleasant, he’s not an unattractive candidate, whether you agree with him or not,” said Hume.'}

{'text': '他又提到他所描述的Trump「與俄羅斯總統Vladimir Putin交好」、表面上「背棄」烏克蘭總統Volodymyr Zelenskyy，以及白宮新聞秘書Katie Zacharia極短暫任期的「鬧劇」。', 'paragraph_context': 'He also cited what he described as Trump’s “cuddling-up to” Russian President Vladimir Putin, his apparent “turning his back” on Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, and the “fiasco” surrounding Katie Zacharia’s extremely short-lived tenure as White House press secretary.'}

{'text': 'Hume說：「我看不到白宮和總統這次競選活動至今有取得什麼明顯進展，那種只要留意競選過程就能察覺到的進展。」', 'paragraph_context': '“I don’t see this White House and this campaigning by the president as having made much headway so far of the kind that you can sort of see just watching the campaigning,” said Hume.'}
